turns.content: Standing up the strata-pg adapter against Postgres 15 — that's the version on RDS we provisioned.
Postgres 15 is fine. tsvector + GIN works the same as 16.
We bumped the Postgres instance to 16 over the weekend. The new MERGE syntax is nicer for the upserts in pipeline-driver.
Good move. PG 16 is current and the MERGE statement does clean up that path.
Heads up — moved to Postgres 17 today. ICU collation handling is meaningfully better and we needed it for the per-user pg_trgm indexes.
Postgres 17 is fresh but stable. ICU was the right call.
